items.en: US firm Cummings Aerospace shows 3D-printed Hellhound S3 vertical-launch jet strike drone, tests two-round launcher on a Polaris vehicle
items.nl: Amerikaans bedrijf Cummings Aerospace toont 3D-geprinte, verticaal gelanceerde Hellhound S3-straalaanvalsdrone en test dubbele lanceerinrichting op Polaris-voertuig
items.sEn: US company Cummings Aerospace has developed the Hellhound S3, a compact jet-powered strike drone with a 3D-printed airframe, Militarnyi reports, citing a company press release via Defence Blog.
